name: M:xr
tagline: Less group chat, more mixers. An AI planner for Kellogg social events.
summary: A team hackathon project that took 2nd place at the Kellogg hackathon. Mixr helps KWEST social chairs plan group events with an AI agent: set the size and budget, find and hold a venue, and match with other groups planning something similar.
problem: Planning a group mixer means weeks of back-and-forth on dates, budgets and venues.
how: An agent chat collects event size, budget per person and dates.
Swipe through suggested venues and place a hold.
Match with other groups planning a similar event.
Approve the plan, and the event shows up on everyone's calendar and invites.
highlights: Mobile-first prototype with organizer and venue views
